text:
maria: heads up — after flipping act-quant on AWQ for ll-3-70b (group_size=64) in canary, we saw a bunch of weird serving behavior: long-tail token stalls and occasional NaNs in logits. rolling back now.

jon: details? was it latency spikes or correctness regressions?

maria: both. 95th latency went from 420ms -> 1.6s under 8k seq mix. also eval suite perplexity increased +2.8 on heldout, and truthbench pass-rate dropped ~1.7%. logs show `inf` and `nan` in kv-cache flush path.

jon: do you have the exact awq config used? group_size + act quant params please.

maria: config snippet: ```
model: ll-3-70b-awq
quant: awq
group_size: 64
act_quant: true
act_bits: 4
per_channel: true
```

eva: can you repro locally? maybe the group boundary interacts with attention tiling on our runtime.

maria: repro on staging cpu/gpu combo. reproduced with 3 different seeds. disabling act_quant or lowering group_size to 32 removes the NaNs and latency tails.

jon: ok can you run quick diff: group=32 vs 64 with act_quant on/off and attach the small eval table? even a 100-example prompt set is fine.

maria: posted short table in thread: 
- baseline fp16: ppl=12.9, pass=94.1%
- awq g=64 act=on: ppl=13.2 (+2.3%), pass=92.4% (-1.7%)
- awq g=32 act=on: ppl=13.0 (+0.8%), pass=93.6% (-0.5%)
- awq g=64 act=off: ppl=13.0 (+0.8%), pass=93.9% (-0.2%)

sachin: interesting — looks like act_quant is amplifying group-size sensitivity. could be quantization saturation on post-activation distribution. did you check activation histograms?

maria: yes, act histos for g=64 show heavier tails and several outliers crossing the clipping threshold. g=32 histos are cleaner.

jon: suggests two mitigation paths: (A) lower group_size to 32 for serving profile; (B) keep g=64 but disable act_quant or increase act_bits to 6; (C) add runtime guard to detect NaN logits and fallback to a safer variant. which should we apply to canary?

maria: I rolled canary back to awq g=32 act=on. deploy-bot: rollback triggered by maria at 1876543305.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback executed: service=ll-3-70b-canary, from=awq(g=64,act=on) -> to=awq(g=32,act=on). Incident ID: rwd-20260320-42.

eva: long-term we should add an eval check during model onboarding: run a small adversarial prompt set under different grouping seeds and fail the canary if ppl delta > 1.5% or NaN detected.

jon: agree. I'll open a tiny task to add the runtime NaN-fallback and an onboarding gate.

maria: thanks — for immediate next steps I'm going to: 1) run a batch of g={16,32,48,64} x act_bits={4,6} on the 1k prompt eval, 2) collect activation histos and pick safe defaults, 3) propose a canary policy (start g=32 then ramp to g=64 only if no NaNs and delta<1.0%).

sachin: also add a metric for kv-cache checksum drift — we saw small diffs when the NaNs first appeared. might catch regressions earlier.

maria: noted. will upload artifacts to the onboarding bucket and ping this thread.

jon: thanks team. :thumbsup:
